meta.title: Demolition Master – building demolition game for iPhone
meta.desc: Read the building, pick the right machine, cut the columns and bring it all down. A free demolition game for iPhone.

hero.tagline: Blast, cut and bring it down!
hero.lead: Every level is a real building that collapses like the real thing. Read the structure, pick the right machine, cut the supporting columns and watch it fall.
hero.badge: Coming soon to the App Store

items.p: A sledgehammer can't touch concrete and a wrecking ball bounces off steel. Pick the right machine for every material.
Floors with nothing left to hold them fall under their own weight. Cut one side and the building topples that way.
Plant explosives on the right column, set off gas tanks and keep your combo going for more gold.
Factories, twin towers, office plazas and malls. Every 5th level is a reinforced boss building.
Precious artifacts can turn up in the debris. Lift them out with the Excavation Brush and complete the museum sets.
The same building for everyone, every day, and just one try. Keep your streak alive and share your result.

cta.title: Put on your hard hat
cta.p: Demolition Master is coming to the App Store soon. Questions or ideas? We read every message.

support.title: Support
support.lead: Found a bug or have an idea? Write to us; we usually reply within 2 business days. Please mention your iPhone model and iOS version.

faq.q: I got a new phone. Where is my progress?
faq.a: Your progress is backed up to your iCloud. Sign in with the same Apple ID on the new iPhone and make sure iCloud is on (Settings → your name → iCloud). Open the game and you continue where you left off.

faq.q: My purchase or “No Ads” is missing.
faq.a: Tap “Restore purchases” at the bottom of Store → Packs. Purchases are tied to your Apple ID. Gold packs are consumed, so they cannot be restored; if something went wrong, write to us.
So you can keep your own music playing, the game respects the silent switch. Turn the silent switch off and raise the volume, and check that sound is on in the in-game settings.

faq.q: How do I sign in to Game Center?
faq.a: Sign in under Settings → Game Center, then restart the game.

We do not collect or store any of your data. Your progress lives only on your device and in your own iCloud account; deleting the game removes the copy on the device, and the small iCloud backup stays in your Apple account, which only you control. See the privacy policy for details.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information is kept where while you play Demolition Master (the “App”).

p: None. The App does not ask you to create an account; your name, email or any other personal information is never sent to us, and we run no servers.

sections.h: What is stored on your device and in your iCloud
p: Your game progress (levels, gold, machines, cosmetics, sound and vibration settings) is stored on your device. So you can continue on a new phone, a copy is kept in Apple's iCloud, in the space that belongs to your own Apple ID. We cannot see this copy. You can turn iCloud off in the iPhone Settings.
The App may ask you to sign in to Apple Game Center. Sign-in is handled entirely by Apple; your Game Center account details are not shared with us.

The App may show ads served by Google AdMob. Rewarded ads (watched for extra time or extra gold, for example) are always optional. To serve ads, prevent fraud and measure ad performance, Google may collect from your device: IP address, approximate location, device model and operating system, ad interactions and, only if you allow it, Apple's advertising identifier (IDFA). The App asks for this permission through Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. If you decline, you still see ads, but they are not personalised. You can change this at any time in Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking. How Google uses this data: {google}.
If you buy “No Ads” or a pack that includes it, interstitial ads are no longer shown.
Purchases are processed entirely by Apple through the App Store. We never see your payment details; the App only learns what you bought so it can unlock it.
We do not collect personal data from anyone, including children. If you are a parent and believe there is a problem regarding your child, please contact us.

We hold no data about you, so there is nothing for us to delete or correct. For requests about advertising data under GDPR or similar laws you can contact Google, and you are welcome to send us your questions as well.
If we update this policy, we will change the date on this page.
